notesId:
What's new in v1.5.208:
- The app now has its own folder in Android/data/dev.wndavenz.music.
- Update APKs download into that folder and are reused when already downloaded - no more re-downloading the same update.
- The Log page can now save logs to a file in that folder (files/logs).

Fixes in v1.5.209:
- Fixed the queue index landing on the wrong track when a song was removed during a crossfade.
- Update install failures now show an error instead of closing the dialog as if they succeeded.
